newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Kaifood postpones listing after bad press.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Kaifood postpones listing after bad press.

text.p: South Africa's Kairinos Foods Ltd said on Monday it had decided to withdraw its current prospectus and postpone its proposed listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), planned for later this month.
"The decision for this withdrawal has been taken in the light of recent adverse press comment which has reflected badly on the company," it said in a statement.
Kaifood said it intended to restructure its business incorporating, among other things, high profile brands which would have a positive impact on earnings.
The company said it intended to seek a listing on the JSE later in the year.
